crossRefs.note: “When the sky is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against you; if they pray toward this place…
then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way…
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and…
It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has…
and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying…
Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you…
that Yahweh your God may show us the way in which we should walk, and the things that we should do.”
Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought…
Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear Yahweh our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its…
Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh…
I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There…
It will happen in that day, I will respond,” says Yahweh, “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the…
and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.
“Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahweh, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure…
Ask of Yahweh rain in the spring time, Yahweh who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the…
Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the…
He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.
translations.bsb: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants, Your people Israel, so that You may teach them the good way in which they should walk. May You send rain on the land that You gave Your people as an inheritance.
translations.kjv: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.
translations.asv: then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou teachest them the good way wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
